text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I passed by the racecourse,
a familiar face caught my eye.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: It's finally time for the real race, Meek.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: The "URA Finals" are steadily drawing near.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Let's win decisively and steadily take
our first step toward becoming a star Umamusume...!

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
...Fight, oh.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"...I have to help them win.
Today of all days...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Something about her caught my concern,
so I went to watch Happy Meek's race.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Happy Meek is running!
I've actually been keeping an eye on her.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Still... she hasn't been doing so well lately, has she?
Even though she had great results for a while after her debut."

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: "Hmm, has her growth stalled? Get it together, in-charge Trainer..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then, the race began—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Here comes Happy Meek from the inside!
Will she make it? Can she reach them!?

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"However, the front pack holds on stubbornly!
How will Happy Meek respond with her closing stretch?!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—The leader holds them off to take the wiiin!!
Happy Meek just couldn't find that extra gear!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, Happy Meek finished in 3rd place.
She certainly seemed off her game, but...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry, Meek.
Once again... I couldn't lead you to victory."

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...No.
...It's due to my own lack of ability.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
That's not true!!
...That's not how it is, Meek.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
You are an Umamusume with great potential.
Both your physical and intellectual capabilities are top-notch.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"Therefore, everything...
is my responsibility as her Trainer...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking thoroughly dejected, Trainer Kiryuin
headed back with Happy Meek,
without even noticing we were here...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And later that evening...

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
choice_data_list: Meek!? What are you doing out here all alone?
Meek!? What are you doing here all alone?

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ......They're not here.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
"...My Trainer.
...Is nowhere to be found."

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ……I don't know.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...You're always focused only on me, Trainer.
...Whenever we're together, we only ever talk about me.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ………………Like I said, I don't know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Happy Meek was feeling down.
Still, it was very typical of Trainer Kiryuin,
who was always earnest and deeply caring toward her Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Could I happen to know
where she might have gone...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Trainer Kiryuin is always thinking about her Umamusume, so where would she likely go...?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Meek looks so happy. I had no idea she liked aquariums so much.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...<username>?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Clinging to a glimmer of hope,
I hurried off to the aquarium with Happy Meek.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Bitter Glasse?!
And Trainer <username> too!

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
...I've been looking for you.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Meek...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry for making you worry.
To think I would become a source of stress for my own trainee..."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: I'm... truly a failure of a Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I've caused a lot of trouble
for you too, Trainer <username>...
I'm truly, deeply sorry.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"……I wanted to think it through once more.
About what it is that I should be doing as a Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Still, the more I think about it,
the more pathetic my inexperience feels...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Trainer Kiryuin's competence is beyond question.
Backed by her family's secret 'Trainer White Paper,'
her knowledge is so overwhelmingly profound that none can rival it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her love for Umamusume is more than enough.
However, if there is one thing she lacks,
it would be—
choice_data_list: Did you consult Meek about your worries?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Huh... A-Advice?
A Trainer asking an Umamusume for advice?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I-I've never done that.
Nothing to make you worry like that—
choice_data_list: I think it's fine to let them worry about you.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Huh... What...?
choice_data_list: Is racing something you have to take on all by yourself?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
“Still... but still. Dragging Meek down
with a failure like me is just...”

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...It's, not.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: ...Meek?

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
"...My Trainer is...!
...Not useless at all!!"

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...I want to talk with you, Trainer.
...Not just about me, either.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...I want to know more about you too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
"...I want to think about you too, Trainer.
...Because I want to do my best together with you."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Meek...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: ...What should I do?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"I was supposed to support you,
but I got full of myself and ended up being supported instead..."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: I'm not quite sure what to say...

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...What should I say...?
...Mun...

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...What you want to eat today.
...Favorite jellyfish. ...Things like that?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
C-Come on now... Hehe!
It's not like that.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...Fufufu.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I want to hear it.
Because... I want to keep doing my best together with you.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer <username>.
It seems... you have taught me something once again."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Ah... That's right.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Meek.
Could you wait over there for just a little while?

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...Just a little bit~?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yes, just a little.
I'll be right there.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>.
Once again... thank you so very much.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"So... if you don't mind, would you please
accept my 'Trainer White Paper'?"

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I feel bad offering something secondhand
as a token of my gratitude, but...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
...What happened this time really opened my eyes.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I am still far too green
to properly utilize the 'Trainer White Paper'.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: So first, look up from your book—

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: I think I'll start by looking her straight in the eye.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...However, for someone like you who sees
Umamusume for who they truly are,
it is bound to be a tremendous help.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
This is the accumulated wisdom passed down through generations of the Kiryuin family.
Please, make full use of it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, from Trainer Kiryuin, who seemed somehow refreshed, I received the "Trainer White Paper."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though small, this heavy volume conveys
the pride and passion that have been
handed down through generations...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Well then, please excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: ...I need to talk with Meek a lot!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I watched the two silhouettes
fade side-by-side into the distance for a long, long time...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Kiryuin family's Trainer White Paper.
The secrets of Umamusume training recorded within it contributed greatly to <chrname>'s growth!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me.
I'm going to go talk with Meek.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
About the future... and about me.
...I have so much to talk to them about.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: ...Shall we go, Meek!

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And I watched the backs of the two
as they walked off closely side by side...
